question: If I withdraw from the university today, how much of my tuition will be refunded?
answer:
If you withdraw from the university today, you are not eligible for a tuition refund [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6]. 

Since your withdrawal request is being made 74 days after classes began [SQL], which falls under the category of "More than 30 days after classes begin", the refund policy states that there is no refund [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6]. You have paid a total tuition of ₹1,45,000 [SQL].

Here is the policy breakdown for tuition refunds based on the timing of the withdrawal request:

| Withdrawal request received | Tuition refund |
|---|---|
| Before classes begin | 90% of tuition paid, less a processing fee of ₹1,000 [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6] |
| Within 14 days after classes begin | 75% of tuition paid [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6] |
| 15–30 days after classes begin | 50% of tuition paid [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6] |
| More than 30 days after classes begin | No refund [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6] |
sql: SELECT SUM(amount_paid) AS total_tuition_paid, (CAST('2026-10-27' AS DATE) - MIN(due_date)) AS days_since_classes_began FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2025CS001' AND component LIKE 'tuition%' LIMIT 200
